title: Constructivist pedagogy in conventional on-campus and distance learning practice: An exploratory investigation
reason: Phase 1 is a qualitative expert mailing-list discussion; phase 2 is a 150-item student perception questionnaire on constructivist features of units. No platform-recorded measure and no relation to learning success.

extraction.design: exploratory: qualitative discussion analysis + questionnaire factor analysis
extraction.n_quote: Participants were 642 undergraduate students from one university in Australia of
extraction.population: undergraduates across six faculties, 1 Australian university (36 units)
extraction.notes: All quantitative data are self-report perceptions.
